newsitem.title: GERMANY: German paging service GFD closes doors.
newsitem.headline: German paging service GFD closes doors.

text.p: German paging service Gesellschaft fuer Datenfunk mbH (GFD) has ceased operations, shareholder Mannesmann AG said on Wednesday.
"One reason for the decision are changes in the market for mobile data services," Mannesmann said in a statement.
GfD could not develop European-wide mobile data services as originally planned on the basis of the Mobitex standard, because its partners, two network operators in France, pulled out of the business.
A GFD spokesman said he could not comment on what would happen to the GFD license. "Negotiations are under way. We cannot say more than is in the statement," he said.
Mannesmann said the shareholders would make efforts to provide for the staff customers and contractual partners.
Aside from Mannesmann, GFD's shareholders include RWE AG Deutsche Bank AG and Thyssen AG.
